title: Draft: Qt: Improve Follow Stream menu
description:
Due to the fact, that the menu option is copied around, the Follow Stream
dialog does crash on Windows if the dialog was opened from the context
menu and Wireshark was built with Qt 6.

This change moves the menu to an auto-generated one, based on the registered
streams, therefore creating the menu fresh and avoiding the copy

commits_data.title: Qt: Improve Follow Stream menu
commits_data.message:
Qt: Improve Follow Stream menu

Due to the fact, that the menu option is copied around, the Follow Stream
dialog does crash on Windows if the dialog was opened from the context
menu and Wireshark was built with Qt 6.

This change moves the menu to an auto-generated one, based on the registered
streams, therefore creating the menu fresh and avoiding the copy
